title: Warm Earthy Argentinian Speck Empanadas
description: A festive Argentinian dish featuring speck, nuka-pickle, and cheese, perfect for a snack or dinner. This halal-friendly recipe combines earthy flavors with a delicious cheese pull.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the diced onion until softened.
Add the diced speck to the skillet and cook until crispy.
Stir in the chopped nuka pickle and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked speck mixture, mozzarella cheese, and parmesan cheese.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Spoon a tablespoon of the speck mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the remaining egg wash and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
